Primary objective is to replace brittle in-house agent orchestration with hosted runtime that supports streaming + tool-calling and deterministic latency. Team is pragmatic about cost but will pay for predictable SLOs and small routing fallbacks.

Key contact: VP Product - Jenna Morales (j.morales@summitwise.com). AE intro: Aisha P. Demo + scoping calls with infra and security attended by Michael C.

Stubs: drive deck + security FAQ linked. Will attach fireflies transcript to Jira ticket during POC.

requirements_summary:
Workload: conversational agent with multi-step tool calls (search -> action -> update). Latency SLOs: streaming token latency target p50 < 60ms, end-to-end response p95 < 350ms under typical production sim. Tool-call reliability: require 99.5% success for external tool invocations; timeouts must be configurable (default < 2s for search calls). Throughput: expected steady-state 3-5 rps with burst to 20 rps during peak feature launches; concurrent active sessions ~100-200. Model prefs: open models ok if performance matches; evaluate Redwood-verified and gpt-class baselines. Fallbacks: auto-fallback to quantized smaller model for degraded capacity; route by region (NA primary). Cost sensitivity: moderate — care about tokens/unit economics and batching gains.

Integration needs: streaming websocket or chunked HTTP, function/tool calling SDK, robust error hooks for retries and idempotency, observability hooks (per-route p50/p95, token cost).
poc_plan: Week 1: Baseline latency and streaming test on Hosted API. Instrument p50/p95, token lat, and streaming jitter.
Week 2: Tool-call reliability tests - simulate external search (varying timeouts), measure success rates, retry behaviors, and error handling patterns.
Week 3: Scale & cost run - run 48h peak simulation, capture cost per 1k active sessions; produce Dedicated sizing proposal if SLOs met.
Deliverables: SLO report, demo recording + Fireflies transcript, cost estimate, Dedicated sizing sketch, implementation checklist for SSO/SCIM/KMS.
